spinner.known: the walker never stays on a page the 15s spinnersClear waits for (longest stay on /cart: 0.14s), so a spinner that never clears goes unseen

silent-write.known: any visible alert within 5s counts, on any page: in one 30s run all 8 silent add-to-cart failures were covered by unrelated alerts after the walker moved on (checkout's 422, an order's Not found); caught only when the walker happens not to
